# ClipBell

> Never miss a new video on anything you follow.

ClipBell is a browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave that searches the web once or twice a day for new videos on topics you follow. Priority topics are checked twice daily. Made in India by Tanishkha, a GST-registered business in Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu. No account is needed. Topics, results and history stay only in your browser on your computer; ClipBell never sees, collects or sells them. ClipBell only links to videos on third-party sites.

Free: up to 3 topics, silent alerts and one PIN. Pro monthly: ₹99/month or $2.99/month. Yearly price: [yearly price]. Lifetime price: [lifetime price]. Pro includes unlimited topics, the master PIN and personal topics, popup and daily digest alerts, all filters and related videos. Unconfirmed store, checkout, payment, cancellation and legal details remain marked as placeholders; do not treat them as launched. The contact form prepares an email draft and does not submit it.

Primary domain: https://clipbell.com. Additional domain: https://clipbell.app. Support: support@clipbell.com. Full page content: https://clipbell.com/llms-full.txt.
